articles.title: DHR Q1 Deep Dive: Bioprocessing Momentum and Acquisition Strategy Drive Mixed Start to 2026
articles.mainIdea: DHR Q1 Deep Dive: Bioprocessing Momentum and Acquisition Strategy Drive Mixed Start to 2026
articles.summary: StockStory: DHR Q1 Deep Dive: Bioprocessing Momentum and Acquisition Strategy Drive Mixed Start to 2026. Diversified science and technology company Danaher (NYSE:DHR) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026 as sales rose 3.7% year on year to $5.95 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.06 per share was 6.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
